note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; jurisdiction unspecified. Exactly one datum is substituted (seal state or seal number) and the before value stays traceable; nothing is inferred about tampering, validity, admissibility or custody. Times are illustrative and imply no time limit. Editable brief fields: items, custodians, timestamps, records, focusTarget, beforeValue, afterValue, detailGeometry, contextLabels.
